215:        ("ratio", GOLDEN_RATIO, "Ratio of the tiles"),

217:        ("fancy", False, "Use a different method to calculate window sizes."),
218:    ]

222:        self.add_defaults(RatioTile.defaults)

247:        if self.dirty:

249:            self.last_size = (screen.width, screen.height)

252:            else:
253:                method = gi.get_sizes
254:
255:            self.layout_info = method(screen.width, screen.height, screen.x, screen.y)
